Broadband Systems Corporation sells Starlink to customers in Rwanda as an authorised reseller, with packages for health, education and non-profits and SME packages of up to 300 Mbps planned; article date used.
A country availability table lists Starlink as available in Rwanda.
Starlink is live in Rwanda, listed among early adopters; local-currency plans priced from RWF 40,000 to 549,000 and measured at 267 Mbps down, 37 Mbps up, 27 ms; article date used.
Subscribers: 4,489 at 2025-06, per RURA (Rwanda Utilities Regulatory Authority), Starlink subscribers for Q2 2025 as reported by TechCabal.
Rwanda's regulator issued Starlink's operating licence before its commercial launch in Rwanda in March 2023 (as_of is the launch month; the licence date is not given).

Starlink users in Rwanda record median download speeds of around 75 Mbps, so the service is in use; as_of is the article's published date.
